_note: Orion A (M42, NGC 1976), HII region, at 1420 MHz. Approximate model: total ~400 Jy (uncertainty ~20 %; at 1.4 GHz the core is partly optically thick, so the flux depends on frequency and resolution). Compact core around the Trapezium (~4') plus the extended nebula including M43 (~15'). Use for qualitative simulations only.
